selection_rule: greatest training net_expectancy_r; stable config_id ascending tie-break

m1_coverage.fallback_description: M1 bars were present but covered only 93 of 2000 parent bars (4.65% of the window). Mixing M1 chronology on part of the window with the fallback on the rest would make results inside one study incomparable, so no M1 chronology was used: the whole window was resolved with the conservative pessimistic_same_bar_no_subpath fallback, in which a bar touching both the stop and the target is taken as the stop.

deflated_sharpe_ratio.formula: DSR=Phi((SR-SR*)/sqrt((1-skew*SR+((kurtosis-1)/4)*SR^2)/(n-1))); SR* uses the expected maximum of N independent normal trials

cscv.formula: PBO = fraction of CSCV splits where the in-sample winner ranks in the bottom half out of sample (logit <= 0)

data_sufficiency.reason: 2,000 M15 bars cover roughly 30 days of one symbol.
data_sufficiency.needed: Multiple years of contiguous M15 with covering M1 and measured broker costs spanning varied trend and volatility regimes.
